subject: Reconciliation: usage credits, true-up, and EU VAT on final invoice
messages:
From: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@orchidhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: finance@orchidhealth.com
Date: 2028-06-28T08:12:00+01:00
Subject: Discrepancy in renewal true-up + VAT on final invoice

Hi Karthik,

We reviewed the end-of-term billing for our Dedicated cluster and see a couple of issues that block our AP team from closing this out:

1) Usage credits: our records show a pre-paid credit (PO 5892) that hasn't been applied against the May/June usage line items — see attached Orchid_Usage_Report_Jan-Jun2028.csv.
2) VAT treatment: Redwood's draft final invoice applied 20% VAT. As an EU purchaser with our VAT registration (IT123456789), we expect the reverse-charge mechanism (no VAT charged on your invoice) — please confirm.

Can you: 1) confirm whether the PO credit can be applied to the true-up and 2) reissue the final invoice without VAT (reverse-charge note or blank VAT line) and include our PO number?

We need the corrected invoice by the end of next week (2028-07-06) to meet our month-end close. Attaching usage export for your ops team.

Thanks,
Elena Ramos
Head of Procurement, Orchid Health
elena.ramos@orchidhealth.com
Attachments: Orchid_Usage_Report_Jan-Jun2028.csv
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-28T10:03:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Discrepancy in renewal true-up + VAT on final invoice

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear note and the usage export.

Quick plan:
- I asked Finance to run a provisional true-up that applies PO 5892 as a credit; see attached Draft_TrueUp_Calc_Orchid.xlsx (provisional).
- Vanessa, can your team confirm the legal wording we should use for the reverse-charge note on the invoice? If Orchid can provide the VAT registration (TIN), we can include the reverse-charge statement and remove the VAT line.
- Jonas, can you validate there are no outstanding overages outside of Jan–Jun that would change the numbers?

Elena — if you can confirm the VAT TIN and a billing contact for remittance, we should be able to reissue a corrected invoice by 2028-07-01. Is 14-day payment terms acceptable once the corrected invoice is issued?

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Attachments: Draft_TrueUp_Calc_Orchid.xlsx
From: Marco Bianchi <marco.bianchi@orchidhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@orchidhealth.com>
Date: 2028-06-29T09:15:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Discrepancy in renewal true-up + VAT on final invoice

Hi Karthik,

Quick fiscal confirmation from Orchid Finance: our EU VAT TIN is IT123456789. We will accept the corrected invoice with reverse-charge wording. PO 5892 should cover the credit amount shown in column F of the attached usage export.

Two requests from our side:
- Include our PO number on the invoice line so our AP can auto-match.
- Update the invoice footer to include: "Reverse charge — Article 194 VAT Directive (no VAT charged). Orchid Health VAT ID: IT123456789."

We can sign the amendment if needed — I've pasted a DocuSign link below for an addendum that acknowledges the true-up credit.

Thanks,
Marco Bianchi
Finance Manager, Orchid Health
Attachments: (referenced)
Related link: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC-123-ORCHID
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@orchidhealth.com>, Marco Bianchi <marco.bianchi@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-30T11:40:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Discrepancy in renewal true-up + VAT on final invoice

Hi Elena & Marco — copying finance and operations teams to confirm next steps.

Summary of actions Redwood will take:
- Apply PO 5892 as a credit against the true-up and reissue the final invoice net of VAT (reverse-charge note included).
- Reissue final invoice ID DW-9876 (Final_Invoice_DW-9876.pdf) with PO 5892 visible on the invoice lines.
- Provide bank remittance details and updated payment terms: 14 days from invoice date.

Please confirm you are happy with these items and whether the DocuSign amendment is required on your side — if you confirm we will: 1) finalize numbers, 2) run the corrected invoice through Finance, and 3) upload the signed invoice to the HubSpot deal record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-0321

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Final_Invoice_DW-9876.pdf
From: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@orchidhealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Marco Bianchi <marco.bianchi@orchidhealth.com>
Date: 2028-07-01T14:05:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Discrepancy in renewal true-up + VAT on final invoice

Hi Vanessa / Karthik —

Confirmed. We accept the plan: please reissue invoice DW-9876 with the PO and reverse-charge wording as discussed. DocuSign is optional for us; we'll rely on the corrected invoice and PO matching to approve payment.

Payment plan: Orchid will clear the corrected invoice within 14 days of receipt. Please send the PDF and the remittance instructions to finance@orchidhealth.com once issued.

Thank you for the quick turnaround.

Best,
Elena Ramos
Head of Procurement, Orchid Health
Attachments: (none)
